title: The9 Limited Announces Rescheduling of Annual General Meeting to December 24, 2026, and Addition of Proposals for Shareholder Approval

body_markdown:
SHANGHAI


, Nov. 23, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- The9 Limited (Nasdaq:NCTY ) (the "Company"), an established Internet company, today announced that, further to its announcement dated November 2, 2026 and the notice of annual general meeting of shareholders (the "AGM") dated November 2, 2026 (the "Original Notice"), the AGM, originally scheduled to be held at 2:00 p.m. (Hong Kong time) on December 4, 2026, has been rescheduled and will be held at 10:00 a.m. (Hong Kong time) on December 24, 2026, at the same venue. The record date for the AGM, originally the close of business on November 4, 2026, has been revised to the close of business on November 25, 2026. In addition, the AGM, which was originally convened solely to serve as an open forum for shareholders and owners and holders of the American Depositary Shares ("ADSs") of the Company to discuss Company affairs with management, will now also consider and vote on the proposals described below.


**AGM**


The AGM will be held at The Bank of New York Mellon Office, Room No. 2602, 26/F Three Pacific Place, 1 Queen's Road East, Wanchai, Hong Kong on December 24, 2026 at 10:00 a.m., Hong Kong time, to consider and vote on the following proposals (the "Proposals") as further detailed in the amended and restated notice of the AGM (the "Notice"), which amends and restates the Original Notice in its entirety:


1. To consider and, if thought fit, pass the following resolution as a special resolution: "THAT, conditional upon the registration by the Registrar of Companies of the Cayman Islands of the solvency statement and minute containing the particulars required under the Companies Act (As Revised) of the Cayman Islands with respect to the Capital Reduction (as defined below):


(a) the par value of each authorised share in the capital of the Company (whether issued or unissued) be reduced from US$0.01 per share to US$0.001 per share and the issued share capital be reduced by cancelling the paid-up capital of the Company to the extent of US$0.009 on each of the then issued shares of the Company (the " **Capital Reduction** ");


(b) the credit arising from the Capital Reduction be transferred to a distributable reserve account of the Company which may be utilised by the Company as the board of directors of the Company may deem fit and permitted under the Companies Act (As Revised) of the Cayman Islands, the Memorandum and Articles of Association of the Company and all relevant applicable laws, including, without limitation, eliminating or setting off any accumulated losses of the Company (if any) from time to time;


(c) as a result of the Capital Reduction, the authorised share capital of the Company shall be changed, FROM: US$500,000,000 divided into 50,000,000,000 shares comprising (i) 43,000,000,000 Class A Ordinary Shares of a par value of US$0.01 each, (ii) 6,000,000,000 Class B Ordinary Shares of a par value of US$0.01 each, and (iii) 1,000,000,000 shares of a par value of US$0.01 each of such class or classes as the board of directors may determine in accordance with the Memorandum and Articles of Association of the Company TO: US$50,000,000 divided into 50,000,000,000 shares comprising (i) 43,000,000,000 Class A Ordinary Shares of a par value of US$0.001 each (the " **New Class A Ordinary Shares** "), (ii) 6,000,000,000 Class B Ordinary Shares of a par value of US$0.001 each (the " **New Class B Ordinary Shares** "), and (iii) 1,000,000,000 shares of a par value of US$0.001 each of such class or classes as the board of directors may determine in accordance with the Memorandum and Articles of Association of the Company (the " **New Undesignated Shares** "), of which 5,472,986,078 New Class A Ordinary Shares and 63,607,334 New Class B Ordinary Shares are issued and are fully paid up and the remainder are unissued; and


(d) each of the New Class A Ordinary Shares, New Class B Ordinary Shares and New Undesignated Shares arising from the Capital Reduction shall rank pari passu in all respects with each other respectively and shall have the rights and privileges and be subject to the restrictions as contained in the Memorandum and Articles of Association of the Company."


2. To consider and, if thought fit, pass the following resolution as a special resolution: "THAT, with effect from the Capital Reduction becoming effective, the Company's Fourth Amended and Restated Memorandum and Articles of Association currently in effect (the " **Current M&AA** ") be amended and restated by the deletion in their entirety and the substitution in their place of the Fifth Amended and Restated Memorandum and Articles of Association in the form attached as Exhibit A to the Notice (the " **Amended M&AA** ") to reflect the Capital Reduction." The material amendments of the Amended M&AA to the Current M&AA are set forth as Exhibit B to the Notice.


The detailed Proposals and additional information regarding the AGM can be found in the Notice and the form of proxy for the AGM. The Notice and the form of proxy for the AGM are available on the Company's website at[http://www.the9.com/](http://www.the9.com/) , and will also be furnished to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (the "SEC") on Form 6-K on or about November 23, 2026. In addition, the Company's proxy materials will be sent to shareholders and ADS holders.


**The board of directors of the Company recommends that the Company's shareholders and ADS holders vote FOR the Proposals.**


The board of directors of the Company has fixed the close of business on November 25, 2026 as the new record date (the "Share Record Date") for determining the holders of the Company's ordinary shares that are entitled to receive notice of, to attend and to vote at, the AGM or any adjourned or postponed meeting thereof. Holders of record of the Company's ordinary shares at the close of business on the Share Record Date are entitled to notice of, to attend and vote at, the AGM or any adjournment or postponement thereof. Owners and holders of the Company's ADSs are welcome to attend the AGM in person. Owners and holders of the Company's ADSs who wish to exercise their voting rights for the underlying Class A ordinary shares must act directly through the depositary of the Company's ADS program, The Bank of New York Mellon, to exercise their voting rights for the underlying Class A ordinary shares if the ADSs are held on the books and records of the Depositary, or indirectly through a bank, brokerage or other securities intermediary, if the ADSs are held by any of them on behalf of holders of the ADSs.


The Company has filed its annual report on Form 20-F (the "Annual Report"), which includes the Company's audited financial statements for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, with the SEC. The Company's Annual Report can be accessed on its website at[http://www.the9.com/](http://www.the9.com/) , as well as on the SEC's website at[http://www.sec.gov/](http://www.sec.gov/) .


Holders of the Company's ordinary shares or ADSs may obtain a hard copy of the Annual Report free of charge by emailing to[\[email protected\]](https://www.prnewswire.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#68011a280b071a18461c000d51460b0705) or by writing to:

**About The9 Limited**


The9 Limited (Nasdaq:NCTY ) is a global, diversified high-tech company redefining how games are created, played and monetized. Founded in 1999 and listed on Nasdaq in 2004, The9 brings more than two decades of gaming experience to its flagship platform, the9bit, an AI-powered digital asset


ecosystem built around AI game creation and the $9BIT token


economy. Participants can play games, create content, earn rewards and share in the ecosystem's growth. Beyond the9bit, The9 continues to explore emerging opportunities across AI-enabled industries and the broader digital ecosystem, including its equity interest in AI-driven drug discovery company NYB, as it builds a multi-engine business at the intersection of AI and the new economy.
